sources.title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Act No. 35 of 2019)
sources.issuing_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India / Legislative Department
sources.amendment_information: Repealed and replaced Consumer Protection Act, 1986
sources.description: Foundational primary legislation providing protection of consumer rights, establishment of Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA), Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions, mediation, and product liability.

sources.title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
sources.issuing_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
sources.description: Rules governing unfair trade practices in e-commerce, obligations of marketplace and inventory e-commerce entities, seller duties, grievance officer appointment, and refund/return policies.

sources.title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2021
sources.issuing_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
sources.amendment_information: Draft amendments regarding flash sales, mis-selling, cross-selling, and fallback liability of marketplace entities.
sources.description: Statutory amendments addressing flash sales restrictions, fallback liability for e-commerce entities, appointment of chief compliance officer, and nodal contact person.

sources.title: Consumer Protection (Mediation) Rules, 2020
sources.issuing_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
sources.description: Rules laying down procedure of reference to mediation under Section 37, fees, panels of mediators, and procedure for mediation cell attached to Consumer Commissions.

sources.title: Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020
sources.issuing_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
sources.description: Rules detailing appointment of President and members, terms of office, salaries, and administrative procedure for District, State, and National Consumer Commissions.

sources.title: Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, State Commission and National Commission) Rules, 2021
sources.issuing_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
sources.amendment_information: Substituted pecuniary limits: District Commission up to Rs 50 Lakhs, State Commission Rs 50 Lakhs to Rs 2 Crores, National Commission above Rs 2 Crores
sources.description: Statutory notification redefining the pecuniary jurisdiction of District Commissions (up to ₹50 lakh), State Commissions (> ₹50 lakh to ₹2 crore), and National Commission (> ₹2 crore).

sources.title: Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements and Endorsements for Misleading Advertisements, 2022
sources.description: Comprehensive CCPA guidelines prohibiting surrogate advertising, bait advertising, defining transparent disclosures, and laying down due diligence requirements for manufacturers and celebrity endorsers.

sources.title: National Consumer Helpline (NCH) Grievance Handling Procedure and Citizen FAQs
sources.issuing_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
sources.description: Standard operating procedure for registering consumer grievances via toll-free helpline (1915), online portal, SMS, WhatsApp, and UMANG app, explaining pre-litigation mediation with convergence partners.

sources.title: e-Jagriti / e-Daakhil Online Consumer Dispute Filing Portal Citizen User Manual
sources.issuing_authority: National Informatics Centre (NIC) / National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC)
sources.description: Official step-by-step citizen guide for filing digital consumer complaints, electronic fee payment, tracking case status, video-conferencing hearing setup, and scrutiny objection handling.
